## Problem

What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way today?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see. Rough is fine.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about, if any.

## Fit with Lucerna's principles

Lucerna ships no telemetry, never modifies the Minecraft client, and routes all
network through a reviewed allowlist (see
[docs/PRINCIPLES.md](../../docs/PRINCIPLES.md)). If your idea touches networking,
processes, or data collection, note how it stays within those bounds.

## Additional context

Anything else — references, screenshots, prior art in other launchers.
